content.user_title: Plan Practical Entryways and Home Studies
content.value_statement: Poorly planned entryways and study areas can waste storage, block daylight, and restrict movement. This skill uses renovation references to suggest layouts suited to your space, household, and budget.
actual_capabilities: Select relevant guidance from 28 Chinese-language entryway and study references.
Compare shoe cabinet layouts, adjustable shelves, bench placement, and everyday storage needs.
Explain how entryway partitions and furniture affect daylight, privacy, and circulation.
Suggest compact study layouts combining desks, bookcases, wardrobes, or guest sleeping areas.
Compare open and enclosed book storage and describe pegboard options for small items.
Provide safety checklists and reminders to verify wall structure, property rules, and waterproofing before renovation.
limitations: Provides text-based planning advice, not measured drawings, structural assessments, or construction approval.
Several references are incomplete article extracts with missing images, repeated captions, or promotional fragments.
Lighting, sound isolation, and child ergonomics receive broad guidance rather than detailed technical specifications.
Does not provide live prices, verified product availability, or automatic checks against local building regulations.

use_cases.title: Organize a Small Apartment Entrance
use_cases.description: Compare compact shoe storage and seating options while preserving door clearance, daylight, and a usable passage.

use_cases.title: Create a Shared Work and Study Area
use_cases.description: Explore desk and bookcase arrangements for adult work and child study, with separate storage and lighting considerations.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Client Layout Discussion
use_cases.description: Use the references to compare entryway and study concepts and identify measurements and professional checks needed before detailed design.

prompt_templates.title: Start With Entryway Priorities
prompt_templates.prompt: My entrance opens directly into the living room. Two adults need storage for shoes, coats, and keys. Suggest priorities and ask for missing measurements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: identify needs before choosing furniture.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Shoe Storage Options
prompt_templates.prompt: My available entryway wall measures [width] by [depth]. We store [number] pairs, including boots, and need seating for [users]. Compare freestanding and custom cabinets. Explain shelf flexibility, door clearance, and maintenance tradeoffs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare storage against household requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Arrange a Compact Study
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a study measuring [length] by [width], with doors and windows at [positions]. It serves [users] and stores [book quantity]. Compare straight and L-shaped layouts. Address chair movement, daylight, glare, and storage access. Cite relevant bundled references and state assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Combined Renovation Proposal
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this entryway and study proposal: [layout, dimensions, users, budget, and proposed alterations]. Compare a furniture-only option with an alteration option. Identify circulation, lighting, storage, and child-safety concerns. List structural, property, electrical, and waterproofing checks requiring professional confirmation. Separate reference-supported advice from assumptions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: assess tradeoffs and prepare questions for qualified professionals.

output_examples.input: Our apartment has no separate hallway. How can we store shoes without blocking the living room?
output: Start with storage along an available side wall, rather than adding a barrier directly opposite the entrance.
A low cabinet may suit a small shoe collection; higher storage needs may justify a larger cabinet where space allows.
Keep everyday shoes accessible and use adjustable shelves for seasonal changes.
Measure the door swing, available wall, and remaining passage before choosing cabinet dimensions.

output_examples.input: I need a small study with book storage and an occasional guest bed.
output: Compare a desk and bookcase along one wall with a sofa bed on the opposite side.
An L-shaped desk is another option if it preserves access to the door and storage.
Check both working and sleeping arrangements, including chair movement and the fully opened bed.
Choose enclosed storage where dust is a concern, and keep frequently used items within easy reach.
Confirm room dimensions and window positions before selecting either layout.

best_practices: Provide measured dimensions, door swings, window positions, household needs, and budget before requesting a layout.
Ask for alternative arrangements and reference citations, with assumptions and missing information stated clearly.
Have qualified professionals verify structural changes, electrical work, mounting loads, and applicable local requirements.
anti_patterns: Copying a reference layout without checking circulation, daylight, or actual storage needs.
Treating article dimensions or AI suggestions as approved construction specifications.
Assuming referenced images, purchase prompts, and historical product claims are complete or currently available.

faq.question: Which AI tools are listed as supported?
faq.answer: The package lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Its guidance is provided through Markdown instructions and reference articles.

faq.question: Is the source material in English?
faq.answer: The instructions and references are primarily Chinese. You can request English explanations, but this is not a professionally translated design manual.

faq.question: Can it help when my home has no separate entryway?
faq.answer: Yes. Several references discuss side-wall storage, low cabinets, and layouts that preserve circulation without adding a separate hallway.

faq.question: Does it generate construction drawings or rendered images?
faq.answer: No dedicated drawing or rendering tools are included. The package supports text-based planning, and many referenced article images are absent.

faq.question: Can it confirm whether a wall can be removed?
faq.answer: No. It calls for checking wall structure, property rules, and waterproofing, but cannot replace an on-site professional assessment.

faq.question: Does it connect to shops or provide current prices?
faq.answer: No shopping integration or live pricing service is included. Some reference articles contain copied promotional text that should not be treated as current offers.
